name: Kling AI Global Plugin
tagline: Official Kling MCP with 4K video and optional HDR where available
description: Official Kling AI Global remote MCP with browser OAuth. Kling 4.0 supports native 4K video and optional 10-bit HDR at 1080p or 4K when available in live MCP tools; HDR uses additional Global account credits. Generate images and videos, manage Elements, use motion control, and track tasks. Global and China accounts, credits, and tasks are separate. Official npm Plugin: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/plugin-global ; CLI: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/cli-global . Setup: https://kling.ai/app/mcp/guide . Kling Image 4.0 is live in Kling Creative Studio and via API; confirm its availability through live tool discovery.

install.notes: Authenticate with a Kling Global account. Image or video generation consumes that account's credits. Kling 4.0 HDR may incur additional usage charges and requires live account/tool support.
